replacements.after: For d>0, a uniform detection inequality is equivalent to a uniform positive lower bound for the least eigenvalue of the Hermitian Gram matrix A_X* A_X. When d=0 the detection inequality is vacuous; use the equivalent quadratic-form inequality A_X* A_X >= K^(-1) Id on the zero vector space, without referring to a least eigenvalue. If floor(X)<d, rank-nullity gives a nonzero form with all sampled coefficients zero.
